newsitem.title: DENMARK: Wall Street gains boost Danish shares.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street gains boost Danish shares.

text.p: Danish share prices rose on Wednesday morning, boosted by Wall Street gains and a strong dollar. Dealers expect the Danish rise to continue throughout the day.
"Sentiment on the Danish market was good on the first two days of the week. That will continue on Wednesday," a trader said.
At 0715 GMT the KFX top-20 index was up 0.87 point from Wednesday's close, to 155.61.
Tele Danmark was an early mover, gaining seven crowns to 342.00 after revising an earlier profits warning.
